newsitem.title: USA: Clinton accepts resignation of protocol chief.
newsitem.headline: Clinton accepts resignation of protocol chief.

text.p: President Clinton on Thursday accepted the resignation of his long-time chief of protocol, Molly Raiser, effective July 24.

"She made foreign guests feel welcome when they visited the United States, and helped me feel at home whenever I travelled aboard," Clinton said in a statement. "She represented me, and the interests of our nation, with insight, judgment and grace."
Raiser had been chief of protocol, working out of the State Department, since Clinton began his first term in 1993.
The statement gave no reason for her departure, but several White House staffers are moving on as Clinton's second term gets under way.
